sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore collapse pressures BHP, RIO, FMG. Gold miners (FOR.AX, KAL.AX, AUK.AX, LRV.AX) outperform on safe-haven demand and project milestones.
sectors.implications: Rotate out of iron ore/coal exposure; overweight gold and diversified miners with hedged revenue. BHP.AX faces margin compression risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising oil → inflation → RBA rate-hike expectations pressure bank valuations. Qantas $35M payout signals corporate cost pressures. ATO vs Big Tech adds regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face NIM compression risk if RBA hikes. Super fraud crackdown (headline 7) may boost fund manager volumes (HUB.AX, PPT.AX).

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Santos gas cartel breaking (headline 36) signals competitive restructuring. Rising oil (>US$100) benefits upstream but pressures downstream and transport.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX faces margin pressure from cartel break; upstream producers (WDS.AX, AVE.AX) benefit from oil spike. Watch LNG contract repricing.

sectors.trend: Highly negative. 'GFC moment' narrative, collapsing buyer sentiment, NZ crash spillover, construction capacity crisis. Mortgage costs driving second-job participation.
sectors.implications: AVH.AX, CGP.AX, DGP.AX under pressure. Construction names (WBC.AX exposure, GPT.AX) face demand destruction. Defensive rotation warranted.

sectors.trend: Negative. Qantas (QAN.AX) $35M redundancy payout; car supply crunch raising insurance premiums; retail weakness (102-year-old mall retailer closes 25 stores).
sectors.implications: QAN.AX cost base elevated; WES.AX, WOW.AX face consumer squeeze from mortgage stress. Insurance (CGF.AX, WBC.AX) premiums rising but claims also up.

sectors.trend: Neutral. No major ASX-specific headlines. Global: Moderna comparison, Dell/HPE divergence, Oracle EU regulatory warning. ATO-Big Tech tax fight adds uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) relatively insulated. Tech exposure via GPP.AX, W1.AX faces ATO scrutiny.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from oil-driven rate-hike fears, iron ore collapse, and property stress. Banks and materials lead declines. Gold miners and upstream energy are relative outperformers. Expect ^AXJO volatility above 2% daily. RBA hawkish commentary likely within 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil spike is transitory and China stimulus materialises. Gold miners offer structural upside. Property sector may stabilise by H2 2027. Energy restructuring (Santos) creates M&A opportunities. Key risk: prolonged geopolitical conflict keeping oil >$100 and forcing sustained RBA tightening.
